text.description_html:
Deltana DSH35U32D 3-1/2" x 3-1/2" x Square Corners Stainless Steel Spring Hinge

Packaged complete with One (1) single action stainless steel spring door hinge, tension adjusting allen wrench, adjusting pin, locking pin, plus stainless steel #9 x 3/4" wood screws and #9-24 x 1/2" machine screws. Utilizes standard template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

The included Allen Wrench Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pin holds the Spring in tension after it is set to the desired closing force.

These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes).

Also available: 3-1/2" x 3-1/2" Steel Spring Hinge in other finish colors.

Specifications for the Deltana DSH35U32D Stainless Steel Spring Hinge:

  • Hinge Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Height: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 3-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.097" (Residential)
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Certified: R19063 UL Listed Door Closer Body 57YM
  • Stainless Steel Wood Screws: #9 x 3/4"
  • Stainless Steel Machine Screws: #9-24 x 1/2"
  • Deltana DSH35U32D Hinge Specifications (PDF)
  • Deltana Spring Hinge Installation Instructions (PDF)

Sold Individually. (One (1) spring door hinge)
